meta.scope: P1 proposed UI copy; not installed into production resources
meta.protected: User text, filenames, source quotes, URLs and brand names are not translated.

app.design_only.zh: P1静态设计 · 合成示例 · 不可操作
app.design_only.en: P1 static design · Synthetic example · Not interactive

task.next_hint.zh: 先处理需要你行动的工作
task.next_hint.en: Start with work that needs your attention

task.search.zh: 搜索任务名称或负责人

task.empty.zh: 暂时没有需要你处理的工作
task.empty.en: Nothing needs your attention right now

task.empty_filter.zh: 没有符合条件的任务，可以调整筛选。
task.empty_filter.en: No tasks match. Try changing the filters.

task.denied.zh: 你当前不能访问这个任务。
task.denied.en: You cannot access this task right now.

task.changed.zh: 任务安排已更新，请核对最新要求。
task.changed.en: The task has changed. Check the latest requirements.

create.no_auto_replace.zh: 继续讨论不会自动修改已选定作品。
create.no_auto_replace.en: Further discussion will not replace your current work automatically.

create.input.en: Describe what you want to change

create.generating.zh: 正在生成，当前作品不受影响。
create.generating.en: Generating. Your current work will stay unchanged.

create.not_configured.zh: 当前文字模型尚未接通。输入仍保留。
create.not_configured.en: The text model is not connected. Your input is retained.

create.failed.zh: 生成未完成，输入和当前作品仍保留。
create.failed.en: Generation did not finish. Your input and current work are retained.

create.budget.zh: 本次生成超出可用额度，未生成作品。
create.budget.en: This request exceeds the available budget. No work was generated.

create.select_replace.zh: 当前作品有未保存修改。请先保存，或确认替换。
create.select_replace.en: Your current work has unsaved changes. Save it first or confirm replacement.

create.free.zh: 自由创作 · 尚未关联任务

create.select_task.en: Which task should this work be saved to?

create.only_selected.zh: 只保存选定作品，不保存整段聊天。
create.only_selected.en: Save only the selected work, not the whole conversation.

work.submit_confirm.zh: 提交这份作品及勾选附件审核？聊天记录不会送审。
work.submit_confirm.en: Submit this work and the selected attachments? The conversation will not be submitted.

work.submitted.zh: 已提交审核，可在本任务查看反馈。
work.submitted.en: Submitted for review. Follow feedback in this task.

work.save_failed.zh: 保存失败，输入仍保留，未提交审核。
work.save_failed.en: Save failed. Your input is retained and has not been submitted for review.

work.conflict.zh: 服务器上有更新内容。你的输入不会被覆盖。
work.conflict.en: Newer content exists on the server. Your input will not be overwritten.

work.unknown.zh: 保存结果未确认，请先核对，暂不重复新建。
work.unknown.en: The save result is unknown. Check it before creating another item.

work.changed_during_save.zh: 保存期间内容又有修改，请再次保存后送审。
work.changed_during_save.en: The content changed while saving. Save it again before submitting.

work.restore.zh: 发现未保存输入，是否先预览恢复内容？
work.restore.en: Unsaved input was found. Preview it before restoring?

work.leave.zh: 离开前请保存，或选择保留草稿。
work.leave.en: Save your work or choose to keep a draft before leaving.

work.frozen.zh: 本次送审作品只读。修改后需要重新审核。
work.frozen.en: The submitted work is read-only. Changes require a new review.

file.uploaded.zh: 已上传，尚未用于本次生成
file.uploaded.en: Uploaded, not used in this generation

file.unconfirmed.zh: 尚未确认是否用于本次生成
file.unconfirmed.en: Use in this generation is not confirmed

file.unreadable.zh: 当前模型不能读取此文件。可保留为任务附件。
file.unreadable.en: The current model cannot read this file. It can remain a task attachment.

file.denied.zh: 无法确认这份资料的使用权限，未发送给模型。
file.denied.en: Permission to use this material could not be confirmed. It was not sent to the model.

file.failed.zh: 上传未完成，文件未加入本次作品。
file.failed.en: Upload did not finish. The file was not added to this work.

review.fixed.zh: 本次送审正文及附件只读
review.fixed.en: The submitted text and attachments are read-only

review.comments.zh: 退回时，请写明要修改哪里。
review.comments.en: When requesting changes, explain what needs to change.

review.comments_required.zh: 请填写具体修改意见后再退回。
review.comments_required.en: Enter specific feedback before requesting changes.

review.confirm.zh: 确认提交这次审核决定？

review.pending_professional.zh: 发布审批：等待专业审核通过

review.denied.zh: 你当前不能审核这份作品，未提交决定。
review.denied.en: You cannot review this work right now. No decision was submitted.

review.self.zh: 不能审核自己创作或提交的作品。
review.self.en: You cannot review work you created or submitted yourself.

review.changed.zh: 送审作品已经变化，请重新核对，不能沿用旧批准。
review.changed.en: The submitted work has changed. Check it again; the previous approval cannot be reused.

review.unknown.zh: 审核结果未确认，请先刷新核对，不要重复提交。
review.unknown.en: The review result is unknown. Refresh and check before submitting again.

review.approved_not_published.zh: 作品已批准，可安排发布；这不表示已经对外发布。
review.approved_not_published.en: The work is approved and can be scheduled. It has not necessarily been published.

context.switch.zh: 切换品牌或任务前，请先处理当前未保存内容。
context.switch.en: Handle your unsaved work before switching brands or tasks.

context.revoked.zh: 资料权限已变化，已停止使用相关引用。
context.revoked.en: Access to the material has changed. The affected references are no longer being used.
